notes: «- يعني ابن بلال -» is an editor's gloss, left out; the name is «سليمان».
Umar is the last link: he answers Ibn Abbas's question («فقال تلك حفصة وعائشة»), and the rest of his story is his own words.
The Prophet is the end; the speakers inside Umar's account (Hafsa, Umm Salama) are in the scene.
